name: Anime Town Greenville
blurb: A Halloween-themed ('Spooky Matsuri') stop of the Anime Town multi-city tour, with anime voice actors, cosplay and gaming in Greenville, SC.

editions.evidence: Own page: 'ANIME TOWN LOCATIONS OCTOBER 30TH-NOVEMBER 1ST,2026 The Greenville Convention Center' and 'OCT 30TH, 3:00 PM 2026 – NOV 01, 4:00 PM, 2026 Greenville Convention Center HALL ONE, 1 Exposition Dr, Greenville, SC 29607'.

notes: The FEATURED GUESTS/FEATURED REUNIONS cards carry no name or alt text in the page markup (opaque Wix image hashes only) — each guest's name and character are printed directly on their promo graphic, so the 10 real guests (#2-11) were read off the card images themselves, not guessed. #12-14 ('FEATURED REUNIONS') are theme re-groupings of the same 10 people (Resident Evil trio Robertson/Gill/Tompkins; Eric Stuart + Dan Green shown again for both Pokémon and Yu-Gi-Oh!) so were not picked twice. Felecia Angelle's specific role could not be confidently identified from her card's artwork, so known-for is left blank for her. Anime Town is a multi-city tour; Huntsville, Biloxi, Bossier City/Louisiana and Pensacola are separate files — this is the only one of the five with a confirmed edition still ahead of 2026-10-05.
